messages:
sophia: Heads-up — trying to merge PR #9872 but it's gated on an arch RFC review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9872 RFC: https://go/redwood/rfcs/arch-routing-2026. Can someone from architecture give a quick lightweight buy-in? We want to land in tomorrow's 2h maintenance window (09:00-11:00 UTC).

sophia: This touches routing policy, fallback behavior, and telemetry tags. Minimal change but higher-risk for cross-tenant routing. Quick snippet of the config change below: 
```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer-low-latency
  fallback: regional-cost
telemetry:
  tag: route_v2
```

raj: I can take ownership of the PR and add the compatibility matrix tonight. Quick q: do we require a canary? If so, what percent/time?

sophia: yes canary recommended. SRE suggested 5% for 30m. Also need a brief note on leader/shard compatibility for versions <=1.4.

sophia: @james — can you eyeball safety implications? If arch won't bless, we'll postpone the window.

james: Skimming the RFC now. Primary concern is client compatibility and KV cache behavior when fallback triggers. Please add a short compat table for leader versions and expected behavior, and a perf estimate (p50/p95 delta).

raj: added compat table and a small perf section to the PR description — local perf run shows ~3% qps regression on our perf harness. Updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9872

olivia: SRE: we can permit the 09:00-11:00 UTC window if arch signs off and we run a 5% canary for 30m with telemetry tag route_v2. Prep rollback runbook and monitor the latency/error dashboards closely.

deploy-bot: CI: integration tests failed (tests/telemetry::test-tagging flaky). Re-run queued.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on rerun — ready to merge when approvals are in.

james: Arch: lightweight bless given. Minor doc wording nit but no safety blockers. Please record the RFC approval note for audit.

sophia: Thanks all — scheduling merge for 09:05 UTC (canary 5% x30m). I'll post the rollback playbook and ping SRE on the day. :thumbsup:
